messages:
sam: handing off to @anya for the evening (I’m around until ~22:30). Quick FYI watchlist below — non-incident but noisy signals to keep an eye on. links: https://dash.redwood.local/kv-prefetch | https://dash.redwood.local/encoder-pool

oncall-bot: ALERT NOTE: KV_PREFETCH_LAT_P95 has been sporadically >150ms in the last 30m (low sev). ENCODER_POOL_FREE dropped to 1-2 for ~5m. No customer impact detected.

anya: ack — thanks. do we want to silence anything or just monitor? who do i ping if encoder scaling is needed?

sam: monitor for now. don’t silence KV_PREFETCH_LAT_P95 unless it's > 300ms sustained or >3 alerts in 10m. If encoder_free < 2 for >10m and tail latency rises, scale encoder pool or flip the fallback variant. ping infra-team or @kevin for capacity ops.

sam: quick runbook snippets:
```
# manual scale (temp)
infractl scale --pool encoder --replicas 3 --reason "oncall temporary scale"
# rollback model variant
redwoodctl rollout cancel --route encoder-fallback
```

kevin: noted. encoder autoscale policy is target=3 replicas @ 80% utilization; last deploy bumped model mem usage ~8% which made the pool sit lower. I can pre-authorize a +1 replica if needed.

marta: the KV_PREFETCH alert has been noisy for a week — we muted a low sev once but it came back. Suggest we add a short dampening rule or change alert to anomaly-based. Filing a follow-up task tomorrow. :eyes:

sam: thanks @marta — please include the prefix-cache eviction rate and the recent customer rollout (svc: feature/x) in the ticket. could be correlated.

anya: saw a couple of "eviction spikes" in the prefetch dashboard around 19:50, correlates with spike in cold misses. I'll keep an eye. If I see p95 > 350ms I'll escalate to oncall infra and trigger scale.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished by @emily at 2026-03-17T18:40Z — service=prefix-cache v=3.2.9

kevin: FYI if you need to scale quickly, we have a warm spare node in eu-west that can be added to encoder pool; i'd still prefer short autoscale but spare is available.

anya: taking watch for the next 8h. will post updates here if anything degrades. catching up on runbook now. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — handoff complete. main things to watch: KV_PREFETCH_LAT_P95 (thresholds: 150ms watch, 300ms escalate), ENCODER_POOL_FREE (<2 sustained escalate), eviction_rate %+ >5% over baseline. escalate to infra@redwood or @kevin if you need manual capacity.

marta: ping me tomorrow during sync; will propose alert tuning and a short playbook to reduce noise.

anya: copied. leaving a quick note in the runbook and tag the ticket."
